prerequisites: JDK 21 or newer with java and javac
POSIX shell for run.sh, or direct Java commands
persistence: none; fake records and Outcome values are memory-only
idempotency_scope: one FakeProvider object and key; identical payload required
idempotency_retention: object lifetime; no expiry; new object empty
reconciliation: trusted positive fake lookup resolves acceptance; NOT_FOUND stays UNKNOWN without send
